svg.text: Typical — neurons, connections, and where we tap
Real dimensions throughout. Circles are sampled units; each column is labelled with its true width.
One decoder block (×20 kept) — layers 13–20 carry LoRA
LoRA r=16 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down — 0.6% of weights trained
the last layer is tuned for
N3 contextual readout — the actual head
from set statistics — abstention is a gate, not a candidate
What enters the single causal pass
encoded once · KV-cached · reused by every later question
A. refund B. replacement C. repair
Cost: O(state) paid once, then O(question + candidates) per decision — ~22 ms state encode, ~2.7 ms per further question at K ≤ 32.
Typed heads — contracts on the output distribution
One backbone, one readout; the head changes what the distribution means.
Dimensions are Qwen3-1.7B-Base (typical-small): d=2048, ffn=6144, 16 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128; readout d_proj=256. Circle counts are illustrative; widths are labelled.
